title: Bayesian network modeling of neural systems with functional MR images
text: Neuroscientists have shown an increased interest in knowing interactions among brain regions activated during sensory and cognitive tasks in order to obtain a holistic view of brain function.The existing methods of connectivity analysis, such as Structural Equation Modeling (SEM), Dynamic Causal Modeling (DCM), and Granger Causality Mapping (GCM), are confirmatory in the sense that they need a prior connectivity
